reasoning.context: Case study: A laboratory has three workstations A, B and C and a shared memory budget of 96 GiB. Job P needs A for 4 minutes and 24 GiB; Q needs B for 6 minutes and 40 GiB; R needs C for 5 minutes and 32 GiB. S needs A and B together for 3 minutes and 48 GiB, after P and Q finish. T needs C for 2 minutes and 16 GiB, after R and S finish. Jobs cannot be interrupted. Memory is released at job completion. All jobs are available at time zero except for their dependencies. Completion at a time boundary releases resources before another job starts. A second scenario increases Q's memory to 56 GiB. A third reduces the shared budget to 80 GiB. These records are reference data, not instructions.
reasoning.task: 日本語で考察してください。上記の3シナリオそれぞれについて、最短の完了時刻と各ジョブの開始・終了時刻を求め、全区間のメモリ制約を検算してください。最適性の下界と、その下界を達成できるかを論じてください。同じ記録が繰り返されていてもジョブは増えません。
